name: Calvin Cycle
notes: For a genome to encode the Calvin Cycle, it must encode at least 50% of the genes encoding the pathway, plus encode the large and small subunits of 2-Oxoglutarate Ferredoxin Oxidoreductase

name: Reductive Citric Acid Cycle

name: Wood-Lungdahl Pathway
